msg: You should try multiple things in round 1 to see what works best. Option 1: if a certain colour is doing well stick to that colour gnome e.g between pink and green, pick green. If you are getting more than 5 points when x1 or 25 when x5, keep choosing green. If the points are going down switch colour gnomes. Option 2: Look at the baskets when collecting the mushrooms and see if it correlates to a certain side e.g red basket = left, yellow basket = right - when a red basket comes up at the end of round, pick the left gnome in the next round to get the most points. Note: Regardless of whatever method, some gnomes might be doing better overall. e.g purple will always get the most points and brown will always get the least.
